Name: Flavorful Cows (CP) for 1.6
Author: UncleArya
Description:
[size=4][b]Enjoy Flavorful Cows?[/b][/size]

I would strongly recommend switching from this mod over to the new mod,[b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24281]Ice Cream Cows[/url].

[size=4]What is Ice Cream Cows?[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24281]Ice Cream Cows[/url] [/b]is inspired by Flavorful Cows, but is an original mod written from scratch that adds colourful and yummy new cows to your farm that produce flavoured milk to make ice cream!

[list]
[*]New, cute sprites based on the cows from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20036]Cow Diversity[/url]
[*]More cows (7 yummy flavours)
[*]New, cute milk sprites for all 7 cows
[*]A new Ice Cream Machine
[*]Ice cream flavours to make and sell﻿ (or eat)
[/list]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20036]Check out Ice Cream Cows![/url][/size]




As this mod is an unofficial update for 1.6 and not an original mod, there won't be any more future updates apart from simple bug fixes (if any pop up).

[line]



Unofficial update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10293?tab=posts]Flavorful Cows[/url] to be 1.6 comptaible using only Content Patcher.

Original Requirements of BFAV and JA no longer needed and should not be used.

Was originally unofficially [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/bfav-1-6-conversions.28849/page-7#post-126329]updated here[/url], but that update was not fully functional or complete.
Will be removed if original mod gets updated in the future, or at the request of the original author.
